title: helianthemum origanifolium f. serrae
intro: Helianthemum origanifolium f. serrae, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose are attributed to its ability to calm and soothe the nervous system, making it a popular choice for treating anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
